text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the intense clash at the
Satsuki
Sho—the first race of the Classic
Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, check it out. There's some kind of
press
conference on TV.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's it about? ...Wait, I know her.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Isn't that Agnes Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The news quickly circulates around
Tracen
Academy, leaving shock in its
wake.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I, Agnes Tachyon, will be taking an
indefinite
hiatus from racing!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the Triple Crown tour's star
racers is
bowing out. The sudden
announcement renders
the room silent.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon... You showed
astonishing
potential at the Satsuki Sho!
Why stop?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing, you say... And I don't
believe my
running there even reflected
my innate talents.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
You're considered the favorite for both
the
Japanese Derby and the Kikuka Sho!
What has
compelled you to do this?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The light-speed runner of the Satsuki
Sho—and
the Triple Crown
favorite—abruptly announces
her hiatus
mid-tour, leaving the venue
dumbstruck.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon... You clinched victory at
the
Satsuki Sho with your astonishing
running! What's
the meaning of this?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing, you say... And I don't
believe my
running there even reflected
my innate talents.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
But you were on track to seize further
victories!
Why go on hiatus?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have my reasons. The truth is
never a
simple thing, you see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
So, are you officially retiring from
racing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, asking me that question now is
rather
meaningless. Nobody can possibly
know what the
future holds. Not for sure.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That concludes my announcement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Agnes Tachyon leaves
from the
stand. I know where she's
headed, however.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What's... the meaning of this, Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I won't stop you from living your life the
way you
wish to. But...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'd finally settled on making you the
object of my
pursuit...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have my own circumstances.
Besides...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, Trainer. This situation was brought
about
by the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The moment remains vivid in my
mind. You
showed me the potential of
an altogether
different choice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Do we have a single path before us? No,
we do
not. Even if that which we must
prove remains the
same, it's possible
that many paths to doing so
may exist.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The question of whether or not to quit is
trivial
and misguided. In other words, it's
better to ask
how we might reach our
goal, and why at all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What... do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
To think, all this time you've been
listening, you
were oblivious. Heh-heh,
ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm talking about being an advisor for you! I'm going to become your advisor, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh... My advisor?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Manhattan Cafe raise her voice
comes as
something of a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...What is it? Are you opposed?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'm not so much opposed as... confused...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's put it this way. I'll admit that
your
talents and your trainer's expertise
are
impressive, but they're not enough.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As such, I propose supplementing your
strengths
with my scientific know-how.
Simple, yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You'll reach your friend sooner this way.
That's
the gist of it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You also believe... in my friend?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter whether I believe in her
or not.
What matters to me is achieving
my goals.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I really do struggle to make sense of
you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Cafe doesn't seem to be on
board, but I
presume you're less
hesitant?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Someone with your wisdom should be
able to
grasp the merits of my offer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're... not going to agree to
this... are
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, I'm considering it. Agnes
Tachyon's
knowledge really would help
us out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh and Cafe, I assume your friend and I
share the
same vector?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I believe that you'll find a shortcut to
your goal if
you understand how I was
intending to run from
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And as for my half of this room, I think
I'll put an
end to our feud and give it to
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now you can put all your strange and
precious
little dolls in here. It'll be just
like they're having a
little victory
parade.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That... much... space! Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe seems overcome with

temptation. ...The deal's decided.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Right then, let's take another vote.
Those in favor
of me assuming the
advisor role, say "Aye"!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Aye.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Yes, this will do. This will do
nicely...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Plan B is officially underway! Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an unprecedented development,
Agnes
Tachyon joins the team, and sets
Manhattan
Cafe's Classics tour in a
direction nobody could
have
anticipated.
